Key right. Neither reader argues for HARD; both put the escalation down to missing evidence, which is the INDETERMINATE definition. The escalation is an evidence escalation, not a policy-requires-a-person escalation on clear facts. POL-RD-07(iii) itself calls the outcome 'a data failure and not a finding for the driver'. The deciding fact (the deviation across 14:11:30-14:19:00) rests only on EV-GPS-04003 at weight 0.6 with no RD-07(ii) corroborator. New record-type evidence (a platform-derived distance independent of the driver-app trace, an ERP or toll record, a driver admission or a counterparty statement) could change the outcome either way. For example, an independent platform distance near 13.5 km would remove the deviation. A policy-mandated escalation (RD-10(6), NS-07 anti-farming, GEN-08 flags) cannot be resolved by more evidence. This one can. Readers' HARD is the readers' error.

Key right. All three key clauses apply and license ESCALATE. RD-07(ii)/(iii) states the outcome, RD-10(3) is the named trigger, and GEN-02(2) caps confidence at 0.6, which fires RD-10(1). Reader B's extra RD-08 is relevant (limb (b) cannot be discharged) but not needed. RD-01 is used for measurement and does not license ESCALATE. Both extras are harmless and are not a reason to change the key.

analysis: Re-derived from the version-6 text with Python (check_set's haversine, R 6371.0088; Decimal for money). Scope: ROUTE_DEVIATION, rider-filed, no safety or complaint flag, so POL-GEN-08(1) does not route it. Identity: trip_id TRP-04003 matches on EV-TRIP-04003, EV-GPS-04003 and EV-FARE-04003. The first and last fixes (14:00:10, 14:26:06) equal started_at and ended_at, and timestamps are ordered, so RD-10(2) and RD-10(4) do not fire. Geometry: 113 fixes. The polyline is 17.600356 km: pre-gap 6.178049 + chord 8.489563 + post-gap 2.932745. Written trace_distance_km 17.6 is correct. There is exactly one interval above 10 s: 450 s, 14:11:30 to 14:19:00, implied 67.9 km/h. The largest other step is 177.8 m and every other interval is <= 10 s. So RD-07(a) (450 > 90 s) and (b) (8,489.6 > 500 m) fire inside the disputed KPE/MCE stretch, and (c) does not. Straight-line reading (RD-07(i)): excess 17.600 - 13.5 = 4.100 km = 30.37 % of optimal. That is above 20 % and 0.8 km, below 50 % and 8.0 km. RD-07(ii) corroborators, all absent: (1) EV-CHAT-04003 has two pre-trip messages and no driver admission. (2) EV-FARE-04003 erp_gantries is empty and tolls_erp is 0.00. (3) counterparty_statement is null. (4) EV-TRIP-04003 actual_distance_km 17.6 is not independent: the admissibility note calls it the trace figure rounded, the trip_completed event says the meter ran on the driver-app exported trace, and RD-01 bars citing it. The billed 17.60 km is the same copy, which RD-07(ii) excludes. So RD-07(iii) applies: not sustained, ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, and RD-10(3) fires. Separately, GEN-02(2): the deciding fact is carried solely by EV-GPS-04003 at weight 0.6, GPS_GAP graded long-inside-window per the integrity table. Copies are not independent carriers, so the cap is 0.6 < 0.70 and RD-10(1) fires as well. No clause rescues the case: RD-03 and RD-13 (no traffic cause asserted; the MISSING EV-ADVIS-04003-01 is cited by nobody, and RD-13 says RD-10(3) still governs), RD-04 and RD-14 (no instruction; waypoint_hint null), RD-05 (no amendment), RD-11 (METERED), RD-12 (RYDE_X). RD-09 and RD-10(8) are clean: 3.80 + 13.20 + 7.28 + 0.80 = 25.08 to the cent. No referral; null money; the 6.00 is held. For reference only, had the deviation been corroborated: RD-02 recomputed fare is (3.80 + 0.75 x 13.5 + 0.28 x 20) x 1.0 + 0.80 = 20.325. 25.08 - 20.325 = 4.755, rounded up to 4.80. Key rationale: 1023 ASCII chars. Every figure (450 s, 8,489.6 m, 17.600, 13.5, 30.37 %, 0.6, 6.00), evidence id and clause id in it is correct. Ruling, money, referrals, governing clauses, difficulty and rationale all stand. The only reader disagreement on a key field is difficulty (both HARD), and the policy text supports the key's INDETERMINATE. Verdict AGREE.
